data.body: `yaml.load(handle.read())` is called without a `Loader`. On PyYAML 5.1–5.3 this silently falls back to the full loader, which can still construct arbitrary Python objects via certain tags; on PyYAML 5.4+/6.x the `Loader` argument is mandatory and this call raises `TypeError: load() missing 1 required positional argument: 'Loader'`, so the function cannot succeed with current PyYAML versions at all. Use `yaml.safe_load`, which also accepts the file handle directly (no need for `.read()`).
